answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity to a scarce, verifiable resource, for example a small stake locked in escrow, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes expensive instead of free. Reputation then grows like a pearl: each honest transaction adds a layer, and a fresh identity with no history cannot outbid an established one. Finally, put new agents on a ledge of limited privileges that rises only with proven good behavior, so a sybil flood hits a ceiling before it can distort prices or votes.
